main_measure.name: next-72-bar return, top third minus bottom third of forecast (>0) on the 72-bar grid
main_measure.threshold: Welch t >= 2 confirms (with supporting check), Welch t <= -2 rejects

supporting_check.name: top third mean next-72-bar return minus holding-the-coin mean 72-bar return

decided_by: The top-minus-bottom Welch t lies between -2 and 2.
reading: Thirds are equal-size splits of the pooled grid cases sorted by forecast (ties kept in coin/window/time order), and the holding benchmark for the pooled top third is the mean, over its cases, of each case's coin mean 72-bar grid return over all windows; the situation is a positive raw residual share on the long side.
